q: My oldest landed his first sailfish and the hands made sure he got it to the boat, with pictures before a successful release. They also put us on some grouper so we had supper for the night.

We booked a full day with high hopes of landing some mahi mahi, and Chris and Edwin delivered. We caught mahi and wahoo, and the lunch on board was far beyond what we expected. We even had birthday cake on the water.
Steve, Liisa and the entire Go Fish team took such great care of us. Brought home some great fish for the family, and everything from booking to airport drop off was seamless.
We had a party of 12. A half day fishing trip and a sunset catamaran tour with transport. Buses were early, drivers friendly, and both trips were top notch on service, food and crew.
Boats are in great condition. Captain knew the area very well. Great catches, and they take care of all the fish caught. Great experience for the whole family.
I have been fishing with Go Fish so many times I have lost count. Tyler got me out on short notice. The mahi were hitting non stop, as were the jacks. Great crew, great lunch.
Every part of this team treated us like family and went above and beyond. Our first trip like this, and now it is going to be a tradition.
Steve and Liisa made the booking process seamless and shared incredibly helpful tips before our trip. They arranged a private driver who picked us up right at our resort.
Great pricing, very friendly staff, incredible day. Will be returning for sure.

Tyler helped us plan an extraordinary trip to Tamarindo to celebrate our son's college graduation. Every last detail was executed to perfection. Two days on a 31 ft flybridge boat with three great captains was the icing on the cake.
Just took my family for a second time to Costa Rica for the Go Fish experience. We got to do more this time, including an ATV trip and zip lining. Tyler and Justin made sure we all had a blast.
The team was helpful and communication was clear. The whole process was easy and everything went exactly as planned from start to finish.
